name: Kiro
description: Space Capsule V10.4 — Panoramic Space Shuttle Cockpit Viewport & Extended Celestial Planetary Navigation
changelog: V10.4: Re-architected Space Shuttle POV into an ultra-wide panoramic canopy (6.6-radius upper arch, 7.0-radius console sill, and outward-tapered side pillars at X=+/-5.4) eliminating claustrophobic screen borders; expanded cockpit steering pitch/yaw range to +/-120 with enhanced celestial parallax multipliers (0.22); calibrated reachable planetary system coordinates; added interactive tap-to-navigate autopilot on distant target planets; and enabled D-Pad re-centering.
